name: Commercial energy cost management for ComEd-zone food, cold-storage and multi-site grocery accounts (supply procurement + capacity-tag management + demand-response origination + bill audit)
summary: One analyst-led relationship per C&I customer in the ComEd zone: free bill/interval/PLC audit, supply RFP among ARES (supplier-paid mils), capacity-tag (PLC) peak management, and demand-response enrollment with a PJM CSP for curtailable refrigeration/process load. Launch legally without an ABC licence by serving only customers with >1,500 kW aggregate Illinois billing demand (83 IAC 454.30(b)(5)) plus licence-free DR, PLC and audit work; add the founder's own ABC licence once a qualifying electric-industry person is in place. Stage D batch DI, 2026-11-28.
evidence_notes: Licensing: soliciting customers is 'attempts to sell' under 83 IAC 454.20 (DI-S019); Part 454 does not apply to deals for customers with >1,500 kW aggregate Illinois billing demand or to exclusive agents of a single RES (C7-S003). Technical requirement = 1 year electric-industry experience of 'persons used to satisfy' it (C7-S001). No fee, $5,000 bond, 90-180 days (WS11-S023).

Capacity price is A-level: PJM 2028/29 BRA cleared at the $325/MW-day cap in every LDA incl. COMED; a no-cap simulation cleared COMED at $776.69 (DI-S022). COMED cleared 1,105.6 MW of DR. This sustains the PLC/DR pitch to May 2029; after that the price could fall to the floor or rise, so no price growth is modelled.

DR revenue split is A-level for the customer side only: a 2020 Illinois school board packet shows NRG paying the district 70% and Direct Energy 75%, CSP keeping 25-30% (DI-S023). The channel-partner share of the CSP's cut is MISSING; 8% of gross is an E assumption.

Supplier commission levels are D-level: a Chicago BOMA presentation shows supplier adders of $0.001-$0.005/kWh, some with $12k-$18k upfront (DI-S026); trade sites say mils fall with account size (C7-S008, C7-S009). Base 1.5 mils on large exempt accounts is E.
Customer electricity sizes are A-level: Chicago benchmarking 2023 shows independent grocery stores at 2.5-3.3 GWh/yr each (Pete's Fresh Market stores; Shop & Save) (DI-S003).

Public bodies can buy DR through state/city contracts without a channel partner (City Colleges used State of Illinois contract CMS5882960 and City spec 1257550 with CPower) (DI-S024, DI-S025), so public-sector prospects are excluded from the base funnel.
Funnel, churn, partner share and audit hit rates are E.

drivers.sales_start_delay_months__source: Entity + E&O insurance + supplier broker onboarding (ENGIE: inquiry form, reply within 15 business days, nine application documents, DI-S027) + CSP partner agreement. No ABC licence needed for the exempt >1,500 kW segment (C7-S003).
drivers.sales_cycle_months__source: Audit acceptance in days; supply decision tied to contract expiry; DR enrollment tied to delivery-year deadlines (SYN-004 Stage C; DI-S026 advises Sept-Dec sign-up).
drivers.founder_leads_per_month__source: Qualified conversations with controllers/plant managers that yield 12-24 months of bills or interval data. Target list is public (EPA ECHO food/cold-storage registries DI-S017/DI-S018; Chicago benchmarking DI-S003).
drivers.lead_to_proposal_pct__source: Free audit converts to an RFP/PLC proposal; analyst estimate.
drivers.proposal_to_win_pct__source: Heavily solicited buyers (392 ABCs, C7-S007); customers often let several brokers bid. Analyst estimate.
drivers.rep_new_customers_per_month__source: Analyst estimate for a commissioned energy rep.
drivers.referral_new_per_100_active__source: Analyst estimate (CPA, refrigeration-contractor and trade-association referrals).
drivers.monthly_churn_pct__source: ~25% of accounts lost at each 12-36-month renewal (WS11-007 Stage C) => ~1.0-1.6%/month; supplier exits (active ARES in ComEd down 14% y/y, C7-S007) add risk.
drivers.arpc_monthly__source: Blended per account, arithmetic: base = 2.75 GWh x $0.0015/kWh supply residual ($344/mo) + DR partner share on 25% of accounts (0.3 MW x $325/MW-day x 365 x 0.75 accreditation x 8% = $2,135/site/yr => $44/mo) + PLC/gas fees ~$20/mo. Conservative = 1.8 GWh x 1.25 mils + DR on 15% at $175 floor; optimistic = 3.5 GWh x 1.75 mils + DR on 30% at 10% share. Volumes A (DI-S003 grocery stores 2.5-3.3 GWh); mils D (DI-S026, C7-S008); capacity price A (DI-S022); customer DR share 70-75% A (DI-S023); partner share E (MISSING).
drivers.onetime_revenue_per_new_customer__source: Contingency bill-audit recoveries: ~30% hit rate x ~$6k refund/first-year savings x ~35% fee (WS11-010 Stage C, E).
drivers.arpc_annual_growth_pct__source: Mils fixed per contract; capacity collar ends May 2029 (floor $175 would cut DR value 46%; uncapped COMED simulation $776.69 would raise it) (DI-S022).
drivers.gross_margin_pct__source: Commission revenue is near-pure margin; COGS = splits with a licensed ABC partner on sub-1,500 kW deals (assumed 50% split on ~30% of the book in base) and data feeds. Split levels MISSING.
drivers.onetime_gross_margin_pct__source: Audit data-extraction cost only; analyst estimate.
drivers.cac_per_new_customer__source: Travel, site visit, data pulls; analyst estimate.
drivers.fixed_marketing_per_month__source: Trade-association dues/events (food manufacturers, refrigeration), website; analyst estimate.
drivers.dso_days__source: Supplier residuals paid monthly in arrears after the customer pays (C7-S008/C7-S009, D); DR payments settle after the delivery season (DI-S023: district paid at end of DR season).
drivers.dpo_days__source: Partner splits paid after receipt; analyst estimate.
drivers.founder_draw_per_month__source: Set to 0 so peak funding shows business capital need only.
drivers.start_capital_injection__source: Analyst estimate (tools, insurance, bond, travel through ramp).
drivers.ev_multiple__source: Residual commission books typically trade on low multiples; analyst estimate.

transactions.notes: Annual residual = 8.7 GWh x $0.0015/kWh. Store sizes A (DI-S003); mils D/E (DI-S026). Paid monthly in arrears over the term; disclosure of total price incl. broker fee required for licensed ABC deals (C7-S005).
